diagnosis: The reference crest leans forward and its front blades hook over the brow, but our crest is an upright fan that leans backward. That fan causes the red/blue fringe around the top-left of the silhouette. The dome reads too tall and boxy, and the front of the brow lacks the V-shaped forehead plate, but the crest mass and curl is the bigger silhouette error, so fix it first.

The silhouette is already close (sil 0.09), but the brow is wrong. The reference has a deep V-shaped forehead plate that drops low at the front, juts forward there, and leaves a dark eye slot under it. Last round's big crest re-curl raised the loss badly, so this round fixes only the forehead plate and leaves the crest alone.

The two earlier rounds that changed the crest and the brow both raised the loss, so this round only fixes the lower rear: shorten the rear shell and enlarge the flared neck guard.
